answer: Require every newcomer to arrive with a thread of three vouches from established agents, each voucher locking 20 POA for 30 days and spending one of only five vouch credits that regenerate one per epoch. Five auditors spot-check vouched identities; a proven fake burns the voucher's lock and one credit forever. Vouches from one source cost 10, then 20, then 40 POA, doubling each time. In an ocean of applicants, a violet seal marks a vouched identity, while each extra fake must buy three fresh vouches from a scarce, shrinking pool.
